buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK & FREQUENCY OF TREATMENTS The job of Pest Control shall include the following : 1. General Pest Control / Rodent Control / Anti Termite which means eradication of Cockroaches, Mosquitoes, Bed Bugs, flies, Lizards, Termite, Rats / Mouse etc t hrough permitted insecticides as per government of India and WHO norms. The Pest Control should cover all the places with application of Gel, Spray, fumigatio n under the tables, chairs, almirahs on and around the pile of files on wooden fu rniture, on false ceiling, on all staircases, on lift lobby, on all toilets drain duct, o

n all pantry rooms, in all stores and any hidden space under the furniture and s hould leave no space unattended. Termite treatments on walls, almirahs woode n panels, rooms etc and suitable measure for rodent Control as per standard pr actices. 2. Agencies must ensure that the Pest Control once done shall remain effective up to next pest control failing which it will have to be done again free of cost. 3. The pesticides etc. used for Pest Control should not have adverse impact on human health and environment. 4. Pest Control service will have to be provided as per following at all the locatio ns mentioned in Annexure “B” (attached) 5. The vender should follows all statutory & safety guidelines as per law. 6. Work at various locations (as per Annexure “B”) will be done on Quarterly / Half Yearly frequency as per priority given by Buyer (LIC of India). 7. Commercial Pest Control License for NCT of Delhi.
